integrity: The optimum is proved analytically by an exact failed-state reset and a one-variable global extremum. Finite computations only corroborate identities and constants. The motivating source and closest general random-probing literature were inspected and compared; independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact for the uniform survivor state of the fully connected extended-target model under iid renewal projective probing with finite positive mean waiting time. No claim is made for arbitrary bright initial states, dependent or adaptive schedules, weak measurements, or other graphs.
title: Exact renewal-protocol optimum for first detection on the fully connected quantum model
